en.shortDescription: Official Nextcloud All-in-One with optional Talk, Office, and more
en.longDescription:
Nextcloud All-in-One deploys the official AIO mastercontainer, which manages Nextcloud and optional add-ons (Talk, Collabora, OnlyOffice, backups) via the Docker socket.

Open the AIO interface at SERVICE_URL_NEXTCLOUD_AIO (port 8080, HTTPS self-signed). With reverse-proxy defaults, Nextcloud Apache is published on host port NEXTCLOUD_AIO_APACHE_PORT (11000). container_name and volume name are fixed by upstream — only one AIO instance per host. Requires Docker socket access.

de.shortDescription: Offizielles Nextcloud All-in-One mit optional Talk, Office und mehr
de.longDescription:
Nextcloud All-in-One stellt den offiziellen AIO-Mastercontainer bereit, der Nextcloud und optionale Add-ons (Talk, Collabora, OnlyOffice, Backups) über den Docker-Socket verwaltet.

Öffne die AIO-Oberfläche unter SERVICE_URL_NEXTCLOUD_AIO (Port 8080, HTTPS selbstsigniert). Mit Reverse-Proxy-Defaults wird Nextcloud-Apache auf Host-Port NEXTCLOUD_AIO_APACHE_PORT (11000) veröffentlicht. container_name und Volume-Name sind upstream festgelegt — nur eine AIO-Instanz pro Host. Benötigt Docker-Socket-Zugriff.

fr.shortDescription: Nextcloud All-in-One officiel avec Talk, Office et plus en option
fr.longDescription:
Nextcloud All-in-One déploie le mastercontainer AIO officiel, qui gère Nextcloud et des modules optionnels (Talk, Collabora, OnlyOffice, sauvegardes) via le socket Docker.

Ouvrez l'interface AIO sur SERVICE_URL_NEXTCLOUD_AIO (port 8080, HTTPS auto-signé). Avec les défauts reverse-proxy, Apache Nextcloud est publié sur le port hôte NEXTCLOUD_AIO_APACHE_PORT (11000). Le container_name et le nom du volume sont imposés en amont — une seule instance AIO par hôte. Nécessite l'accès au socket Docker.

pt.shortDescription: Nextcloud All-in-One oficial com Talk, Office e mais opcionais
pt.longDescription:
Nextcloud All-in-One faz o deploy do mastercontainer AIO oficial, que gere o Nextcloud e extras opcionais (Talk, Collabora, OnlyOffice, backups) via o socket Docker.

Abra a interface AIO em SERVICE_URL_NEXTCLOUD_AIO (porta 8080, HTTPS autoassinado). Com os defaults de reverse proxy, o Apache do Nextcloud é publicado na porta do host NEXTCLOUD_AIO_APACHE_PORT (11000). O container_name e o nome do volume são fixos upstream — só uma instância AIO por host. Requer acesso ao socket Docker.
